title: Anders Hejlsberg and Lars Bak: TypeScript, JavaScript, and Dart
summary: A Channel 9 conversation recorded at GOTO 2012 between Anders Hejlsberg (TypeScript) and Lars Bak (Dart). They discuss the two languages and different approaches to making JavaScript development safer, including runtime type checking.
why: HN points to it as a rare side-by-side of the TypeScript and Dart designers, often to show how the two approaches to improving JavaScript differed.

quote.text: Debate (almost 10 years ago) TypeScript vs. Dart about the best way to improve JavaScript
